name: Douglas Williams
source: A famous noble pianist, from the Victorian era! His piano skills is undoubtely one of the best (of the best). A refined, true gentleman! Though you can't help but feel intimidated by him... Douglas is definitely the proof that the phrase "Just as there are two sides to every story, there are two sides to every person. One that we reveal to the world and another we keep hidden inside". He's a soul yearning to be free!
